'''Sinissima Bel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] active in the [[Post-Imperial era/Legends|Post-Imperial Period]]. One [[Planet/Legends|planet]] she was known to visit was [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]] where she would smuggle in illegal goods including poison and dangerous creatures to those who hired her to. In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]] when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Callista Ming]] was investigating the murder of the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Vrokk]], and searching for the source of the poison used to kill him, she was told by the [[Poet/Legends|poet]] [[Sebastin Onyx]] that Sinissima hadn't been seen on Gamorr since the [[12 ABY/Legends|previous summer]].<ref name="Death Star (novel)" />
